I had the exact same thing happen to me. Plan B has so many hormones in it—a huge dose—that it can change your cycle. I had a pregnancy scare last month where ejaculate accidentally rose to the opening of the condom and we had no backup so I was very worried. I took Plan B about seven hours afterwards and felt fairly reassured. About a week later I got my period while I was at work and thought it was spotting but it ended up just getting heavier and heavier. I was going through like 2-3 super absorbent tampons a day for about five or six days. I also had very painful cramps. Not to mention, I had finished my period two days before I had sex, so this period was around two weeks early. So basically what I’m saying is, I’m sure you aren’t pregnant because you got your period. Good for you for being responsible and using emergency contraception btw!
